email.body1:
Jason, saw Prove launched its unified Identity Platform and ProveX after the $40M round led by MassMutual and Capital One Ventures.

A new platform plus fresh capital usually means more in-market financial accounts in play than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where enterprise deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Prove off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jason, quick follow-up for Prove.

Post-raise, the enterprise financial number tends to jump faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit it, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble to recover.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your team needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jason, last bit of proof for Prove.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Prove's reply rate likely compares to other funded fintech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
